name: English
title: fourth person
thesis: You cannot see the fourth dimension. You can recognise it.

coldopen.question: want to understand what you just saw?

ui.modeHint: what you see is a projection: one dimension had to go
ui.howMany: how many edges leave that corner?
ui.noWebgl: This phone can't draw the scene. It needs a browser with WebGL2.

chapters.title: The trick you use every day
lines: Look at this cube. It is drawn on flat glass, and yet you see it as solid.
You already know the trick: far things get smaller, and two straight rails close into a point.
Your eye is handed a flat picture and pulls out of it something with a front and a back. It has always done this, without asking you.
chapters.action: Drag the cube with your finger, and watch the faces stretch.
chapters.done: There: the picture on the screen changed, the cube did not.

chapters.title: One step down
lines: Now the other way round: we take a dimension away from us.
Imagine living inside a sheet of paper. There is no up and no down: only forward, back, left and right.
Someone living there does not see shapes. They see a line: their whole canvas is a strip.
chapters.action: This strip is your entire view. What shape is going past you?
chapters.wrong: Wrong — as expected: from in there you cannot know. But something does come through: how long it lasts, how it grows, how it ends.
chapters.right: Right. Though be honest: you guessed. From in there, there is no way to be sure.
chapters.done: Keep that feeling. In a moment it is you who will be downstairs.

chapters.title: One step up
lines: Now we climb. This is a cube inside a cube — or at least, that is how it reaches us.
It is not a small cube inside a big one: it is eight equal cubes, and none of them is inside any other. It is our view that squashes them like that, the way a cage throws a shadow on a wall.
Move it. You need that to work out what is in front of what, and it is exactly what you do when you move your head.
chapters.action: Turn it with your finger until it turns itself inside out.
chapters.done: The cube that was outside is now inside. Nothing broke: it turned in a direction we do not have.

chapters.title: Shadow or slice
lines: There are two ways a big thing can show itself in a smaller world.
Either it sends its shadow, all at once and flattened. Or it lets you see one slice at a time, sharp.
The shadow keeps everything and confuses you. The slice is clean, and hides all the rest.
chapters.action: Switch between the two until the difference is obvious.
chapters.done: They are the same thing seen two ways. That is not a technical detail: that is the whole problem.

chapters.title: How you recognise it, since you can't see it
lines: I'll be honest with you: you will never see the fourth dimension. Neither will I.
But it always turns up in the same way: as a rule that breaks.
In a cube, three edges leave every corner. Always three. Not here.
chapters.action: Tap a corner and count them.
chapters.wrong: Look again: four edges leave that corner.
chapters.done: Four. In three dimensions there is no way to fit four of them at right angles. The rule broke: that is how you recognise it.

chapters.title: Now it's your turn
lines: From here on you move in that direction too.
The amber slider on the right moves you. None of them can follow you, and while you are out there none of them can even see you.
There is a sealed box, and inside it something you need.
chapters.done: You forced nothing. The box is closed on every side they have.

chapters.title: What even you can't do
lines: Even now you are not seeing the fourth dimension: you are looking at a projection of it, exactly as they were looking at a shadow.
And there is something worse. To really change an object made of four dimensions you would need a time that sits outside all four of them. You do not have that time.
The ladder goes on above you. This is only the step from which you can see the next one.

sealed-box.title: the sealed box
sealed-box.hint: In three dimensions it is closed on every side. Try stepping out of the slice: the amber slider on the right.
sealed-box.solved: you went over a lid that has no over.

rings.title: the two rings
rings.hint: There is no way to separate them from in here.
rings.solved: they were linked. Now they are not, and you broke nothing.

hand.title: the mirrored hand
hand.hint: The lock wants the other hand. Turn it all you like: it will not be enough.
hand.solved: it was a left hand. Now it is a right one.
